request: Nag explicitly asked the entire 18-specialist team and engineers to inspect the installed Emil Kowalski skills and improve their workflow.
routingMeaning: Suggested relevant reading, not a claim that every listed skill has been read. Individual review records contain actual intake. Read full relevant instructions before use.
teamProtocol: Every specialist reads the catalog and full relevant skills before review.
Pair partners challenge the proposed use of each skill against actual character and product goals.
Preserve the same practice for future website engineers; skills do not substitute for rendered evidence or reviewer judgment.
adoptedNow: Native input keyboard behavior is preserved; page-wide playback shortcuts removed.
Hover styles follow hover/pointer capabilities; coarse-pointer fields use 16px text.
UI press and release have explicit short transform-only timings, while keyboard feedback stays immediate.
Tiny character actions retain their own purposeful lead, response and settle beats.
Phone staging gives the existing character more room without changing anatomy.
exceptions: Short UI timing budgets do not compress intentionally requested character performances.
Keyboard Play still plays intentional content.
Expressive SVG path morphs have a different job from composited UI transitions; measure before simplifying.
No React Native, Swift, Sonner or extra UI library is required by the current plain-JavaScript study.
No root text-selection, scrolling or zoom lock; no unnecessary removal of native link feedback.
evidencePolicy: Actual source and rendered images required; code checks alone do not prove visual quality.
Deterministic30fps films preserve playback for review but decoded frames alone do not establish perceived timing.
Desktop pointer emulation is not physical mobile-device validation.
Owner preference, specialist craft judgments and unprimed human response remain separate.
status: All 18 specialists and the motion, visual and interaction engineering teams completed skill intake. All nine pairs confirmed practical workflow recommendations.
